svg.title: The reasoning loop
svg.desc: The reasoning loop as a level map, steps 0 to 8: triage, state the problem, ask what changed, free moves, look while it happens, rank hypotheses, test one, verify, hand over the journal. Steps 0 to 4 change nothing on your PC. A pixel technician hops from step to step and goes back to step 5 when the fix did not hold.
